name: @hoppscotch/c-core
description: High-performance C core for Hoppscotch API testing
author: Hoppscotch (support@hoppscotch.io)

scripts.build: pnpm run configure && cmake --build build --config Release
scripts.build:debug: pnpm run configure:debug && cmake --build build --config Debug
scripts.format: find src include tests -name '*.c' -o -name '*.h' | xargs clang-format -i
scripts.format:check: find src include tests -name '*.c' -o -name '*.h' | xargs clang-format --dry-run --Werror
